reels.title: M44 DART
reels.caption:
Screen points don't count. 🎯

Same board, two plans. One throws 10 minutes a day. One plays darts on his phone. Day 30, his arm is sore. Next day, he throws again. A year later: 444 bullseyes vs 913 phone games.

Listen to the misses turn into thuds.

Send this to someone who's a pro on his phone.

#darts #practice #discipline #habits #motivation

reels.title: M45 CEKIC
reels.caption:
Saved ideas don't hold books. 🔨

Same idea, two plans. One builds 10 minutes a day. One watches makeover videos. Day 30, he hits his thumb. Next day, he builds again. A year later: 20 projects vs 913 videos watched.

Listen to the nails go in faster.

Send this to someone who'll build it "one day."

#diy #woodworking #discipline #habits #motivation
